name: Exempts Actor
description: An actor may bypass a ruleset. Present only for an actor GitHub actually disclosed: the bypass list is returned only to a caller with write access to the ruleset, so ABSENCE OF THIS EDGE IS NOT ABSENCE OF BYPASS. The ruleset node's bypass_observability field carries that distinction, because when nobody bypasses — or nobody could be seen — there is no edge here to carry anything.

actor_type.description: What kind of actor holds the exemption (`Integration`, `OrganizationAdmin`, `RepositoryRole`, `Team`, `DeployKey`) — the same exemption means different things depending on how many people hold it.

bypass_mode.description: `always`, or `pull_request` (the actor may bypass only through a PR). A mode-limited bypass is a narrower claim than an unconditional one.

observable.description: Whether the credential that produced this edge could actually read the bypass list. Always true on an emitted edge — it is carried per-actor so a merged view assembled from several credentials keeps each actor's provenance.

source.description: Which transport disclosed it (`rest_ruleset_detail`, `graphql_bypass_actors`), because the two do not agree for the same credential.
